statements.statement: The patient has a documented history of recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary arteries
The patient's diagnosis codes are R55 and I25.10
Intermittent arrhythmia is suspected as the underlying cause of the patient's collapse events
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The service was ordered to identify the arrhythmic mechanism responsible for the patient's episodes
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on lack of required precertification or prior authorization
